# Do a few cheap base items change an opening on Nightmare 1?

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | items |
| Result | confirmed |
| Created | L2.I3 |
| Updated | L2.I5 |

## Hypothesis

Seeker-sprouts started with five cheap base items (porcupine-spud, boom-spud, vampire-tot, baked-buckler, spud-muffin), about what 200 gold of crates and vendors could buy, lives longer or kills more by 3:30 than the same seed without them. If so, planning gold spending becomes worth a test.

## Method

Seeds 31 (done), 32 and 33, 300 s, bundle loadout, default playbook. Compare with the L2.I1 baselines.

## Findings

Seeker-sprouts with five cheap base items lived to 5:00 on seeds 31, 32 and 33 (3028, 2843 and 2431 kills; 96-177 damage taken; evolutions Overgrowth 252 s, Wildfire Roast 127 s and Hash Harrier 126 s). Baselines on those seeds died at 3:23, 3:08 and 0:52. The bundle is handed over at 0:00, so it is an upper bound. It points to early armor, health and on-hit damage. A paid-crate route did not reproduce it (see gold-spend-planner). The picks route is tested in defense-focus-picks.
